cache_accounting: The normalized V1 usage record does not separate cached input tokens, so all observed input tokens use the standard input rate.
estimate_assumption: Use standard uncached text-token rates for the frozen GPT-5.6 Terra model. The output is an estimate, not an invoice.
long_context_accounting: The small synthetic evaluation is designed to remain below the published long-context threshold; per-request long-context token detail is not present in the normalized V1 usage record.
